intake_root_cases.name: synthetic goldPacket copies bind the existing digest and retain every immutable item and blank judgement
published fifty-item blank gold remains exact, prepares one hundred assignments and creates no human labels
missing all roles preserves both unassigned blank packets, all sources and a distinct adjudicator checklist
one declared reviewer and missing evidence never shrink the selected item denominator or promote coverage
declared PhD CFA engineering and verification provenance remain unverified despite exact supplied evidence
shared affiliation and declared conflicts are retained without inferring dependence or independence
NFKC trim and case identity collisions match agreement and refuse overlapping reviewer handles
aliases cannot conceal an adjudicator collision or repeat an already normalized same-role identity
duplicate or unknown role declarations and nonstring stable handles are refused
a provided verified boolean or expert flag is an unknown field and cannot override intake uncertainty
opaque native evidence is retained byte-for-byte including binary bytes without asserting document authenticity
advertised evidence hash cannot conceal different bytes or reordered buffer attachments
separate exact evidence length and native buffer inventory cardinality are enforced
evidence for another declared reviewer cannot satisfy an identity reference
valid identity evidence cannot be repurposed as qualification or independence evidence
qualification and conflict evidence must name the exact declared qualification or conflict
foreign packet evidence is refused even when the document bytes and own hash are valid
rights evidence bound to another cited source cannot clear the selected source declaration
source ID URL substitution and uncited source declarations are refused without dropping packet sources
duplicate evidence IDs qualification IDs source records and rights claim IDs refuse rather than overwrite
unreferenced but correctly bound evidence stays in the inventory with explicit unreferenced coverage
complete declared rights scope with matching synthetic bytes never becomes actual clearance or release admission
public-origin or licence text without use declarations remains unknown and missing evidence is visible
contradictory allowed and denied uses across claims are exposed mechanically while distinct restrictions stay distinct
requested training or redistribution outside declared scope remains uncovered or restricted
raw gold hash and independently supplied canonical content pin detect altered immutable questions
completed gold judgements notes or annotator declarations cannot be converted back into blank intake
unknown gold fields or a changed judgement vocabulary cannot alter the existing annotation contract
raw packet ordering changes its raw binding while the existing ID-sorted canonical digest stays compatible
intake and settings canonical packet bindings independently refuse foreign packet declarations
all returned bindings own their bytes and input buffers remain unchanged after immutable preparation
canonical report content hash is deterministic through JSON roundtrip and whole-source declarations stay unverified
malformed UTF8 and raw or escaped unpaired Unicode refuse without replacement-byte repair
duplicate decoded JSON members including escaped keys are refused before schema extraction
prototype-like unknown keys malformed JSON BOM and trailing syntax cannot pass a closed input schema
lossy numeric literals negative zero nonfinite values and coercive evidence counts are refused
calendar-invalid verification dates and unknown qualification use or purpose values are refused
byte input proxies subclasses shared backing and boxed hashes cannot execute custom conversion hooks
native Uint8Array subviews and poisoned own byte getters copy the actual native slots without invoking accessors
evidence array accessors proxies sparse entries and unexpected keys refuse without callback invocation
raw byte maxima accept bounded whitespace but independently reject every overlimit input
evidence item count per-file and aggregate byte caps refuse before a partial result can be returned
combined raw input budget refuses an individually bounded plan without truncating evidence
item source alias qualification and claim budgets refuse excess instead of silently dropping selected inputs
strict JSON depth array string node and numeric-token budgets are enforced independently of schema
canonical output expansion refuses the whole report without truncating large Unicode packet copies
executable synthetic guide import prepares bound blank packets and leaves every verification result unknown
